entry.title: Seedroller and keyderiver: cli tools to generate BIP39 seed words and derive BIP380 keys
entry.summary: The email raises an important consideration for users who prefer using dice as a method to generate randomness, suggesting the potential introduction of an explicitly labeled "dice-only" option. This would cater to those who are hesitant to depend on computer algorithms for randomness, providing them with a clearer understanding of the tools they are employing and allowing them to make more informed choices based on their comfort levels. The proposal underscores the necessity of transparency in the methods used for generating randomness, ensuring that users can trust and verify the process according to their preferences.
